correctness.rationale: The source establishes the formal U-extraction and xi identities. The new proof calculates the shifted-monomial operator exactly via H_j(t), proves its stable 2-adic coefficient lattice and exact factor-eight gain, and constructs an initial lattice element for every even m using closed Chebyshev derivative values. This yields all polynomial valuations and the theta coefficient profile. Replayed standard-library checks tested 54 polynomial instances, 797 exact series coefficients, and 12 base value/derivative identities. Finite checks are corroborative only; the symbolic recurrence establishes the infinite theorem.
